message: Hey Jane, I was just wondering about the kind of issues people come to you with at church. Can you share some stories?
Pastor Jane, I am feeling lost and need guidance. I've committed adultery and my conscience is weighing heavily on me. I seek your counsel.
Reminder: The Fellowship Committee is organizing a charity event this Saturday at 10 AM. We hope to see you there!
Thank you, Pastor Jane, for your inspiring sermon last Sunday. It gave me a lot of hope.
Pastor, could you please pray for my mom? She's going through a tough time with her health.
Don't forget about the youth group meeting tonight at 7 PM. We'll be discussing volunteer opportunities!
I'm looking forward to the women's retreat next month. It's always such a rejuvenating experience.
Choir practice will be moved to 5 PM this Thursday. Please let me know if you can't make it.
Pastor, your guidance has been invaluable to me. I've been sober for three months now.
Let's all remember to show kindness and compassion to those around us. Have a blessed day!
